text:
The mind is like a butterfly

that settles on a rose

or flutters in a heap of stinking feces

dives down to an exhausted bus

or rests on the porch, on a chair, a breathing flower

—open and closed rocking Tennessee breeze—

Flies to Texas to a congress

jumps through weeds in oil fields

Some say these rainbow wings have a soul

others say they are empty brain

tiny automatic wings with great eyes

that fix on the page.

translation.title: Butterfly Mind
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the restless jumps of the mind from rose to refuse to page.
